decisions.reason: As a core bakery item closely aligned with our traditional range and craft capabilities, the hearty bread loaf fits a growing market and there is no sign it underperformed.
The guided historic mill tour extends our existing hospitality, tour and experience offering, strengthens the heritage brand, and shows good strategic fit with no negative indication.
A sweet pastry is very close to our established confectionery business, uses existing recipes and production know-how, and in a favorable industry environment there is no clear reason to withdraw it.
